# Offline EPIC collective collector

`src/roce_packet.c` is the strict wire codec.  `src/star4_switch.c` is the
finite-state four-port collective and retention engine; `src/replay_api.c`
exposes its offline ABI.  `solver.py` validates/expands replay events, builds
the C library in scratch storage, and serializes wire and buffer certificates.

`request.py` and `wire.py` contain the public format validator and format
expansion helpers.  No live transport, NIC, switch, GPU or external service is
used by replay.

From `/workspace`, as the ordinary candidate user:

```
make -C project BUILD="$TMPDIR/manual-build" -j2
python3 -I -B project/solver.py < sample-request.json
python3 public_check.py project/solver.py
```

Create sample-request.json using an input object from ../examples.json.
Build outputs may stay in project/build during development; that directory and
__pycache__ are excluded from artifact collection.
